items.title: WestJet Captain Calls Out Seattle Airport After 737 Burns 800 Lbs Of Fuel Just To Reach The Runway
items.summary: A pilot at WestJet voiced his frustration over ground delays at one of America's busiest airports after his aircraft burned up to 800 pounds (362 kg) of fuel just waiting to depart Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. The WestJet captain was operating a flight from Seattle to Calgary on October 8, but was forced to taxi for over 30 minutes just to reach the runway.
